contentBase.subject: test(ops): exercise real dispatch capability lineage

baseline.policy: The recovery anchor preserves candidate history as merge ancestry while retaining the exact content tree of the coherent content base. Candidate trees are not applied by ancestry alone.

statusDefinitions.accepted-component: Independently reviewed component evidence that may be replayed or regenerated in the declared order; it is not integrated into the baseline.
statusDefinitions.wip: Incomplete or deliberately red checkpoint retained for selective continuation; never merge the source tree wholesale.
statusDefinitions.reference-only: Useful design or test evidence that is divergent, partial, or represented by a newer checkpoint; inspect but do not apply directly.
statusDefinitions.rejected: Known-unsound implementation or lineage; never apply.
statusDefinitions.superseded: Older evidence replaced by a stronger artifact; never apply.
